subject: Myth & Symbolism
title: Three Fates and Three Norns
description: A 60-second lesson on Three Fates and Three Norns.

hook.text: The Greek Fates—Clotho, Lachesis, Atropos—spin, measure, and cut the thread of life. Three control destiny.

buildup.text: Norse myth has three Norns: Urd, Verdandi, and Skuld. Past, present, future. Time itself is a trio.

discovery.text: Shakespeare's three witches echo the same pattern. 'When shall we three meet again?' Destiny speaks in threes.

twist.text: In each tradition, the three figures are female. Women control fate while male gods control power. A reversal.

climax.text: Three fate-figures say destiny has stages: creation, duration, and end. Life is a thread with three handlers.

punchline.text: One spins. One measures. One cuts.

quiz.question: What do the three Norns in Norse myth represent?
